pages.title: Minecraft Ender Dragon Sitting with Egg Coloring Page
pages.description: Sitting beside a large spotted egg, a stylized Minecraft Ender Dragon with outstretched wings breathes smoke in this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Anime Ender Dragon Girl Sitting on Block Coloring Page
pages.description: Sitting on a spotted block, an anime-style Minecraft Ender Dragon girl with dragon wings, horns, and a segmented tail appears in this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Cute Minecraft Ender Dragon with Crystal Coloring Page
pages.description: Featuring a friendly blocky Minecraft Ender Dragon leaning over an End crystal with heart-shaped eyes, this printable coloring page shows wide wings and small sparkling accents.
